# Descript Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that works with Descript's API (open beta): list projects, inspect Underlord/agent jobs, submit a publish job, and poll the job until it finishes. Publishing sends content live and burns Descript credits — the skill always confirms the project first. Honest note: Descript usage is credit-based; every publish job costs credits, and the publish request body may need adjusting per project. Descript has a free plan. Draft: written from Descript's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
